interactive.description: Enable interactive menu (chntpw -i) — lists users and prompts for selection. Note: this is not a command-line flag; use 'username' instead. We include it for completeness but recommend not using it in non-interactive config contexts.

list_users.description: List all users in the SAM database and exit (chntpw -l).

username.description: Username or RID of user to edit. If empty, defaults to 'Administrator' when used in non-list mode. Must be empty or non-empty string.

log_changes.description: Log all changed hive filenames to /tmp/changed and auto-save without prompting (chntpw -L). Use with caution in multiuser environments.

safe_mode.description: Do not allocate more space, only allow in-place editing (chntpw -N).

no_expand.description: Do not expand the hive file (chntpw -E).

verbose.description: Print verbose information and debug messages (chntpw -v).

registry_editor.description: Launch registry editor with write support (chntpw -e).

sam_file.description: Path to SAM registry hive file (required positional argument).

system_file.description: Path to SYSTEM registry hive file (optional).

security_file.description: Path to SECURITY registry hive file (optional).

other_hive_files.description: List of additional registry hive file paths to open (optional). Items are strings representing file paths.
